id: title:Gilbert09:classify invalidaccesskeyid as a permission refusal on our own bucket

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion pipeline error classification and recovery
review.reason: Adds AWS credential rotation error message recognition, corresponding test, and parameterized permission error handling. This could help PostHog distinguish credential rotation failures from other permission or transient errors, potentially changing retry behavior and classification. No evidence of actual adoption or incident avoidance.
review.uncertainty: Changes are bounded and implementation is visible, but unverified outcomes and actual benefit are not established.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds a new permission error message to the tuple of recognized permission-denied errors.
observations.code_quote: "The AWS Access Key Id you provided does not exist in our records.",
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion pipeline to recognize AWS credential rotation errors as permission failures rather than transient or other errors, potentially changing error classification and retry behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case for the new credential-rotation error message alongside the existing access-denied case.
observations.code_quote: ("invalid_access_key_id", "The AWS Access Key Id you provided does not exist in our records."),
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for warehouse ingestion failures caused by AWS credential rotation, distinguishing this from other permission or transient errors.

observations.behavior: Updates the permission error message used in the warehouse ingestion test to use the parameterized error_message instead of a hardcoded string.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports the parameterized permission-denied test, allowing warehouse ingestion failures to be classified and reported consistently regardless of the specific AWS error message returned.
